## 2025 Posit Table Challenge

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(reactable)
library(crosstalk)
library(htmltools)

passes_table <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aohulme/STAT-6341/refs/heads/main/passes_table.csv")

## color bars
color_bar_style <- function(values, color) {
  max_val <- max(values[values > 0], na.rm = TRUE) #scale only by positive values
  function(value) {
    if (is.na(value) || value <= 0) {
      list()
    } else {
      width <- (value / max_val) * 100
      list(
        background = paste0(
          "linear-gradient(to right, ", color, " ", width, "%, transparent ", width, "%)"
        )
      )
    }
  }
}


## creating dropdown menu to select season and team filters
shared_passes <- SharedData$new(passes_table)

## dropdown filters
season_filter <- filter_select(
  id = "season_filter",
  label = "Select Season:",
  sharedData = shared_passes,
  group = ~season
)

team_filter <- filter_select(
  id = "team_filter",
  label = "Select Team:",
  sharedData = shared_passes,
  group = ~team
)

## reactable table
table <- reactable(
  shared_passes,
  columns = list(
    game_id = colDef(name = "Game ID", align = "center", style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
    week = colDef(name = "Week", align = "center", style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
    season = colDef(name = "Season", align = "center", style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
    team = colDef(name = "Team", align = "center", style = list(fontWeight = "bold")),
    pass_left = colDef("Passes Left\n(Avg Yds)", style = color_bar_style(passes_table$pass_left, "salmon")),
    pass_middle = colDef("Passes Middle\n(Avg Yds)", style = color_bar_style(passes_table$pass_middle, "salmon")),
    pass_right = colDef("Passes Right\n(Avg Yds)", style = color_bar_style(passes_table$pass_right, "salmon")),
    run_left = colDef("Runs Left\n(Avg Yds)", style = color_bar_style(passes_table$run_left, "lightgreen")),
    run_middle = colDef("Runs Middle\n(Avg Yds)", style = color_bar_style(passes_table$run_middle, "lightgreen")),
    run_right = colDef("Runs Right\n(Avg Yds)", style = color_bar_style(passes_table$run_right, "lightgreen")),
    tot_pass_yards = colDef("Total Pass Yards"),
    ypa = colDef("Avg Yards/Pass", style = color_bar_style(passes_table$ypa, "lightblue")),
    total_int = colDef("Interceptions"),
    total_sacks = colDef("Sacks"),
    total_punts = colDef("Punts"),
    opponent = colDef("Opponent"),
    point_diff = colDef("Point Differential\n(Team - Opp)", 
                        style = function(value) {
                          list(color = ifelse(value >= 0, "darkgreen", "firebrick"), fontWeight = "bold")
                        }),
    Winner = colDef("Winner", html = TRUE, align = "center")
  ),
  defaultColDef = colDef(headerStyle = list(whiteSpace = "normal"), minWidth = 120),
  style = list(tableLayout = "fixed"),
  defaultPageSize = 10,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 20),
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  searchable = TRUE
)

## displaying filters with table
htmltools::browsable(
  tagList(
    tags$h2("Team Passing & Running Stats"),
    tags$div(style = "display:flex; gap:20px; margin-bottom:15px;",
             season_filter, team_filter),
    table
  )
)

```
